text:
maya.v: Heads-up: QuasarVault closed an enterprise renewal + signed our Marketplace MSA. Deal ~ $520k ARR, includes Dedicated + Private connector with HSM integration. They moved from a mix of on-prem infra to a single Private deployment and asked for a joint case study. Massive thanks to @owen_k for the technical lead and @rachel.sales for the negotiation. :trophy: :clap:

owen_k: Technical wins: migrated three inference jobs into a single autoscaled pool, enabled HSM-backed KMS, and applied our int4 quant pipeline. Early numbers show ~45% token cost reduction and ~25% P50 latency improvement for their fraud-detection model. I'll drop charts into the doc.

rachel.sales: Sales note: renewal signed with a 24-month commitment and professional services add-on. Customer requested a joint press release and a short on-stage demo at their summit in June.

devin_ops: Migration summary: rolling canary 10/30/60 over 36h, no rollback. Small hiccup: NFS mount timeout during node drain (seen for ~0.8% of pods) fixed by bumping mountProbe to 45s. Added rollback snippet and emergency revert command to the runbook: `redwoodctl cluster revert --cluster quasar-prod --to-tag v2025-11-03`.

brand-marketing: Please feed a 1-2 sentence customer quote + logo assets. Suggest coordinating cadence: draft PR next Wed, announce after final legal sign-off. cc @legal-bot.

legal-bot: Marketplace MSA + data addendum signed. One small amendment on breach notification timeline accepted. Docs uploaded to /legal/marketplace/quasar-msas.

quasar-bot: Customer quote submitted: "Redwood's Dedicated + Private connector gave us the throughput and security we needed to run model inference on sensitive data at scale." 10Quasar CTO

maya.v: Great. I'll create the case-study draft and tag the product/ops learnings. Please add exact latency/cost lines as single bullets (marketing requests concise metrics). Also planning a short internal postmortem-lite for eng-ops.

owen_k: Action items: (1) Add quant profile config to Redwood Optimize recipes. (2) Publish a short "HSM integration checklist" in docs. (3) Share perf graphs in eng-ml.

rachel.sales: I'll coordinate customer PR approval and booth demo logistics for June summit. Sales playbook: capture renewal + MSA negotiation steps as a template.

deploy-bot: Created task PR-4880 (case study + press assets). Staging deploy scheduled 2025-02-20T16:00:00Z.

maya.v: Thanks everyone 5 celebration note: team lunch next Thurs 12:30 in kitchen. :sandwich:

devin_ops: Adding migration notes and the small NFS workaround to ops-runbook.

brand-marketing: Will draft the press teaser and share for review by EOD Friday.

maya.v: Closing loop: upload final customer-approved quote + logo to the newsroom folder and we'll publish after marketing/legal ok. :sparkles:
